 It's the first week of the high school football  playoffs in New Orleans, and this will be the place to keep up with scores from the important prep contests in the metro area and across South Louisiana.
 Holy Cross-John Ehret, John Curtis-Huntington and Country Day-Pope John Paul II are among the big games being played on Friday night in the New Orleans area.
 You can help post live high school football scores to our website via the Scorestream app or the Scorestream website . CLICK HERE for instructions on how to do so.
 Some of the big games we'll be following on Friday include:
 Holy Cross vs. John Ehret at Memtsas
 John Curtis vs. Huntington at Bertolino
 Bonnabel vs. Peabody at Yenni
 Country Day at Pope John Paul II
 Woodlawn-BR at St. Paul’s
